run_auto_benchmark: run the SGLang auto benchmark from a YAML config file
convert_dataset: convert sharegpt or custom dataset into canonical autobench JSONL format
validate_dataset: validate a canonical autobench JSONL dataset with a tokenizer
build_parser: build an argparse parser with run, convert, and validate subcommands
add_dataset_args: add dataset arguments like kind, path, tokenizer, and model to a parser
